name: GSE62254 reconstructed published NRRS
feature_mapping: NCBI GPL570 annotation dated 2016-08-09; retain probes unambiguously assigned to one target gene
duplicate_feature_policy: arithmetic mean of all retained probes per gene
normalization_reference: within GSE62254 z-score for each gene using sample SD ddof=1
cutoff_rule: cohort median; ties assigned by sorted GEO ID to balance groups
output_definition: continuous NRRS and deterministic high/low group
source: Published coefficients from DOI 10.1186/s12885-025-15202-9; preprocessing and cutoff reconstructed by this pilot
notes: This contract permits reproducible cohort analysis but is not a deployable single-patient transform because the reference distribution is cohort-specific.
